hook.kn: ಸಾವಿರ ಪಿಯು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಎತ್ತರ ಅಳೆದು ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ: ಅದು ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಖರಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿ ಎರಡೂ ಕಡೆ ಸಮವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಘಂಟೆಯಾಕಾರವೇ ಪ್ರಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿತರಣೆ.

objectives.en: Write the normal probability density function
List the properties of the normal curve

narration.en: Measure the heights of a thousand PU students and draw the histogram: it rises to a peak in the middle and falls away evenly on both sides. That bell shape is the normal distribution, the most important distribution in statistics.
narration.kn: ಸಾವಿರ ಪಿಯು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಎತ್ತರ ಅಳೆದು ಆಯತಚಿತ್ರ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ: ಅದು ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಖರಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿ ಎರಡೂ ಕಡೆ ಸಮವಾಗಿ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಘಂಟೆಯಾಕಾರವೇ ಪ್ರಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿತರಣೆ.

body.en: A continuous variate $X$ is normal with mean $\mu$ and variance $\sigma^2$, $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$, if its p.d.f. is $f(x) = \dfrac{1}{\sigma\sqrt{2\pi}} e^{-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}$, $-\infty < x < \infty$. The two parameters are $\mu$ (location) and $\sigma$ (spread). The total area under the curve is 1.
body.kn: X ~ N(μ, σ²) ಆದರೆ ಅದರ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತಾ ಸಾಂದ್ರತಾ ಫಲನ f(x) = 1/(σ√2π) · e^(−(x−μ)²/2σ²). μ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು, σ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಒಟ್ಟು ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ 1.

narration.en: A normal variate has the density one over sigma root two pi, times e to the power minus x minus mu squared over two sigma squared. Mu fixes where the bell stands, sigma fixes how wide it is, and the total area under it is one.
narration.kn: X ~ N(μ, σ²) ಆದರೆ ಅದರ ಸಂಭವನೀಯತಾ ಸಾಂದ್ರತಾ ಫಲನ f(x) = 1/(σ√2π) · e^(−(x−μ)²/2σ²). μ ಸ್ಥಾನವನ್ನು, σ ಹರಡುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಒಟ್ಟು ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ 1.

narration.en: The teacher draws the bell curve, marks the mean and the inflection points, and shades the 68–95–99.7 areas.

say.en: Here is the standard bell: highest at the mean, falling off symmetrically on both sides.
The mean, median and mode all sit at the centre line.
At mu plus and minus sigma the curve changes its bend. These are the points of inflection.
About 68 percent of the area lies within one sigma, 95 percent within two and 99.7 percent within three.

body.en: The curve is bell-shaped and symmetric about $x = \mu$; mean = median = mode. Skewness $\beta_1 = 0$ and kurtosis $\beta_2 = 3$ (mesokurtic). The maximum ordinate is $\dfrac{1}{\sigma\sqrt{2\pi}}$ at $x = \mu$. Points of inflection are at $\mu \pm \sigma$. The curve is asymptotic to the x-axis. Quartile deviation $\approx \tfrac{2}{3}\sigma$ and mean deviation $\approx \tfrac{4}{5}\sigma$. Areas: $\mu \pm \sigma$: 68.27%, $\mu \pm 2\sigma$: 95.45%, $\mu \pm 3\sigma$: 99.73%.
body.kn: ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ μ ಸುತ್ತ ಸಮಮಿತೀಯ; ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ = ಬಹುಲಕ. β₁ = 0, β₂ = 3. ನಮನ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು μ ± σ. ಚತುರ್ಥಕ ವಿಚಲನ ≈ 2σ/3, ಸರಾಸರಿ ವಿಚಲನ ≈ 4σ/5. ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣಗಳು 68.27%, 95.45%, 99.73%.

points.en: Inflection at μ ± σ; asymptotic to x-axis

narration.en: The curve is bell-shaped and symmetric about x = mu; mean = median = mode. Skewness beta_1 = 0 and kurtosis beta_2 = 3 (mesokurtic). The maximum ordinate is dfrac1sigmaroot2pi at x = mu. Points of inflection are at mu ± sigma. The curve is asymptotic to the x-axis. Quartile deviation approx tfrac23sigma and mean deviation approx tfrac45sigma. Areas: mu ± sigma: 68.27%, mu ± 2sigma: 95.45%, mu ± 3sigma: 99.73%.
narration.kn: ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆ μ ಸುತ್ತ ಸಮಮಿತೀಯ; ಸರಾಸರಿ = ಮಧ್ಯಾಂಕ = ಬಹುಲಕ. β₁ = 0, β₂ = 3. ನಮನ ಬಿಂದುಗಳು μ ± σ. ಚತುರ್ಥಕ ವಿಚಲನ ≈ 2σ/3, ಸರಾಸರಿ ವಿಚಲನ ≈ 4σ/5. ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣಗಳು 68.27%, 95.45%, 99.73%.

caption.en: N(μ, σ²) in yellow against the standard normal N(0, 1) in blue. Slide μ and σ.

narration.en: Move mu: the bell slides along the axis without changing shape. Move sigma: a larger sigma makes the bell lower and wider, because the area must stay one.

tryThis.en: Double σ. What happens to the height of the peak?
Set μ = 2: does the shape change?
Read off μ ± σ and check where the curve bends.

problem.en: Heights of PU students are normal with mean 160 cm and s.d. 6 cm. Write the limits that contain about 68.27%, 95.45% and 99.73% of the students. Also find QD and MD.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Heights of PU students are normal with mean 160 cm and s.d. 6 cm. Write the limits that contain about 68.27%, 95.45% and 99.73% of the students. Also find QD and MD.

body.en: Remember three numbers for 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations: about 68, 95 and 99.7 percent. Almost nothing lies beyond 3σ, which is why control limits are set at ±3σ.

narration.en: The 68–95–99.7 rule. Remember three numbers for 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations: about 68, 95 and 99.7 percent. Almost nothing lies beyond 3σ, which is why control limits are set at ±3σ.
